title: S09T02 - Define MCP read/write permission tiers
description: Separate read-only context/search/status tools from mutating work/memory commands and require explicit command contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Read tools are safe by default.
Mutating tools return command previews and audit operation IDs.
closedReason: Defined MCP read/write permission tiers in core and docs, with tests proving safe read defaults and fail-closed mutating command contracts.
